company.name: Scentbird
company.shortDescription: Scentbird enables its users to choose and get supply of sample designer fragrances on a monthly basis before buying them.
company.description:
Scentbird is the only company that gives women who love switching perfumes access to hundreds of designer and niche fragrances for $14.95 a month.

Our algorithm is placing each consumer in one of the 8 Fragrance archetypes which ensures accurate suggestions.

Our technology is disrupting a $40B perfume market with margins as high as 70%.

productsAndServices.description: A recurring service that lets members select from more than 1,100 designer perfumes and colognes and receive an 8 mL travel vial each month.
productsAndServices.name: Scentbird Fragrance Subscription

productsAndServices.description: An online catalog for purchasing perfume and cologne samples, travel sprays, full-size fragrances, and products from designer and independent fragrance brands.
productsAndServices.name: Perfume and Cologne Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: A sampling service for skincare and other beauty products, allowing customers to discover formulas from selected beauty brands through recurring deliveries.
productsAndServices.name: Beauty Subscription

productsAndServices.description: A digital recommendation tool that uses a customer’s fragrance preferences to identify scent families and suggest suitable perfumes or colognes.
productsAndServices.name: Scent Profile and Fragrance Quiz

productsAndServices.description: Protective cases and related accessories designed to hold and transport Scentbird fragrance vials for everyday or travel use.
productsAndServices.name: Fragrance Cases and Travel Accessories

productsAndServices.description: A retail collection of scented products including car fragrances, home diffusers, candles, colognes, bath-and-body items, and deodorants.
productsAndServices.name: Home, Car, and Personal Fragrance Products

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $820,000, or 2.77% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $772,821 to $49,012,921, a 63.42x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 48 (-11 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-18).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Noteology, Fragrancex, Mindgames Fragrances.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
